parameters.description:
`freemobile-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `freemobile` payload that includes your credential field. The gateway forwards it to the upstream Free Mobile endpoint.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel relays your own authenticated payload; the `plus` channel is the metered tier.
parameters.summary: Relay an SMS to your own Free Mobile by posting a native `freemobile` payload to the UnitySVC gateway.
